author: testleb

notes: Once you get 350 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ behind your base to protect future @building_economy/farm.webp@ placements. Ideally you want it near @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this before @age/age_4.webp@ use 2 TC to increase
@landmark_ottomans/sea-gate-castle-3.webp@: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).
Produce @unit_ottomans/great-bombard-4.webp@, Add @unit_siege/ribauldequin-4.webp@ if enemy is making melee units only
Make @building_economy/market.webp@ and @unit_worker/trader.webp@ and send to teammates markets for gold
REMACRO PREPARE FOR CASTLE BY PUTTING @unit_abbasid/imam.webp@( if @technology_ottomans/field-work-1.png@) close to @resource/relics.png@

notes: Make @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ and send to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to get total 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Use @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to build @building_economy/house.webp@
make @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on stone / send rest to sheep
first vill spawn make @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on gold and house / 3 next vill go stagger tree
build your first @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ with a wood villager
move one from food to gold and keep rally on food
at 17 vill move food vill to wood / build a house with gold vill
build 2nd @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ / @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and two@building_military/stable.webp@ with two vill
keep rallying on food and take @technology_ottomans/anatolian-hills-1.webp@ / start to produce sipahi and harass
5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to gather 50@resource/resource_stone.webp@ (long distance gather) & 1 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.webp@
Drop off 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ then go @resource/resource_food.webp@.
When 8 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ go 2 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (1 from @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@ + 1 from @resource/rally.webp@)

@landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@= @unit_siege/trebuchet.webp@ (if eng and they got castle and stuffs or maybe just try this so they come out of base otherwise @unit_siege/mangonel-3.webp@ if infantary or for late game 1x mango + rest @unit_siege/springald.webp@)
1x @building_military/archery-range.webp@ when wood make it 2x @building_military/archery-range.webp@ constant archers for @age/vizier_point.webp@.
1x of the @building_military/archery-range.webp@ should be @building_military/barracks.webp@if light or heavy cavalary.

pump archers + @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ = sipahi +@landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@= @unit_siege/trebuchet.webp@ (if eng and they got castle and stuffs or maybe just try this so they come out of base otherwise @unit_siege/mangonel-3.webp@ if infantary or for late game 1x mango + rest @unit_siege/springald.webp@)
@technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ if possible to ram maybe outer tower otherwise @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ .

add 2x @building_military/stable.webp@ have aroun 4-5 prod building. 2x archer 2x stable maybe.
